results.message: What happened with the CI job token exposed in a public fork?
results.answer: A CI job token was found exposed in plain text in a public fork's job log. The token was revoked shortly after discovery at 07:50 UTC. An audit of the logs showed that the token was not used before its revocation. The root cause was identified as a debug flag that printed CI variables in job logs, which has since been fixed and the debug flag removed [1][2][3].

results.message: What is the Q3 team restructuring plan?
results.answer:
The Q3 team restructuring plan includes several key changes:

- Delivery will receive one additional SRE headcount to reduce on-call load.
- The Plan and Create teams will merge their weekly planning into one meeting.
- Data Stores will move under the VP of Engineering directly.
- There will be no role eliminations, and hiring for the new SRE role will open after the announcement on October 15, 2026 [2].

results.answer:
For planned time off (PTO), you should provide at least twice as many days of advance notice as the duration of your planned absence. For example, if you plan to take 3 days off, you need to give at least 6 business days of notice to your manager and coordinate with your team [2][5].

results.message: Why was an index added on merge request diffs, and when?
results.answer: An index was added on the merge request diffs table to improve query performance on the merge request page, reducing query times from approximately 900 ms to around 120 ms at the 95th percentile. This migration was scheduled to run during a maintenance window on Thursday, August 7, 2026, as communicated by Meera Iyer in a Slack thread [1] and documented in an associated GitLab issue [2].
